omitted.reason: Collapsed into 'Other' by the top-10 limit, so it has no single intervention_name value to link to.

analysis.evidence_basis: All values are extracted from trial records or computed deterministically from them.

query_interpretation.model_interpretation: Show a network graph of lead sponsors and intervention names (drugs) for clinical trials studying eczema.
plan_adjustments: Built a lead_sponsor / intervention_name co-occurrence graph across the matching trials. Edges mean both values are recorded on the same trial.

invariant.statement: sum(data.edges[].weight) + data.omitted.trials (2,654) >= meta.coverage.records_analyzed (a trial can span several edges)

meta.visualization_rationale: The question is about how two dimensions co-occur.

notes.counting_rule: A trial can be counted in several categories, so the values sum to more than the number of trials.
general: Sponsor names are not entity-resolved: 'Merck Sharp & Dohme LLC' and 'Merck KGaA' are counted as different sponsors.
Showing the top 10 of 725 values; the remaining 715 are grouped into 'Other'.
2,654 trials are not drawn on the graph. Collapsed into 'Other' by the top-10 limit, so it has no single intervention_name value to link to. They are reported in data.omitted.

meta.citation_policy: Citations are extracted mechanically from the ClinicalTrials.gov API response. Field values and excerpts are verbatim; the language model never writes them.
